questions.stem_text:
What fact impinged upon America's 'neutral' stance towards the belligerent in World War I
between 1915 and 1917?

options.A: US banks funded the allies much more than Germany and Austria-Hungary
options.B: US banks funded Germany and Austria-Hungary much more than the allies
options.C: Wilson secretly favoured the German position

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - US banks funded the allies much more than Germany and Austria-Hungary

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Vectors of economic incentives.

questions.stem_text:
Why did George H.W. Bush allow Saddam Hussein to remain in power after the Gulf War of
1991?

options.C: Limited UN mandate and fear of a protracted conflict
options.D: Difficult terrain and fear of civilian casualties

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Limited UN mandate and fear of a protracted conflict

questions.stem_text: What was meant by the term 'American multiplication table'?
